source_documents.title: GHCA Fault Diagnosis and Replacement VST Operation
source_documents.evidence_scope: Exact 20 DTCs listed (19 GHCA, one GCCC), Permanent; type 359, MY2025–2099 as publication scope, build weeks 202402–209952; DC charge still works, AC charge fails

source_documents.title: Propulsion Warning with IEM P0CBC62
source_documents.evidence_scope: IEM P0CBC62, Permanent, vehicle type 534 MY2021–9999, coolant one-way valve check, VIDA phase U/V/W temperature graph; 55°C MY2024 display floor, normal driving below 65°C; 80–100°C in example faulty-condition pattern

application.variant: all relevant type 359 variants listed without engine details

symptoms: AC charging fails but DC charging continues when TJ case applies
records.activation_conditions: Undocumented in public technical journal; do not conflate listed DTC with a standalone failure cause
records.root_cause_context: Manufacturer specifies GHCA replacement only after both AC-fails/DC-works and listed DTC conditions are met; GCCC U01BB00 not proof of GCCC hardware failure

diagnostic_steps.en: Confirm Polestar 3 type 359 with the exact DTC and relevant model/build range in TJ 37630.4.0.
diagnostic_steps.ar: تأكد من Polestar 3 نوع 359، والكود الكامل، والنطاق المصنعي الموجود في النشرة.

diagnostic_steps.en: Confirm AC charging fails but DC fast charging still functions. Both this condition and a listed DTC are required for the TJ.
diagnostic_steps.ar: تحقق من تعطل شحن AC مع استمرار عمل شحن DC؛ يجب اجتماع هذا الشرط مع أحد الرموز المدرجة.

diagnostic_steps.en: Only when both conditions apply, follow Polestar VIDA procedure for GHCA replacement by qualified HV personnel. A code alone does not prove GHCA failure, particularly U01BB00 in GCCC.
diagnostic_steps.ar: فقط عند تحقق الشرطين اتبع إجراء VIDA لاستبدال GHCA بواسطة مختص الجهد العالي؛ وجود الكود وحده لا يثبت تلف GHCA، خصوصاً الرمز الموجود بوحدة GCCC.

diagnostic_steps.en: When the charge behavior does not match the bulletin, continue independent VIDA fault tracing instead of applying this replacement path.
diagnostic_steps.ar: إذا لم يطابق سلوك الشحن النشرة، انتقل إلى فحص VIDA المستقل ولا تطبق استبدال GHCA تلقائياً.

tools_needed: Polestar VIDA
Qualified high-voltage workshop capability for manufacturer-approved replacement

application.variant: IEM-equipped vehicle; one-way valve part varies by drive configuration and model year

symptoms: Propulsion System Service Required display message
Potential reduced propulsion; exact behaviour varies with drivetrain
records.activation_conditions: Undocumented in public technical journal; do not conflate listed DTC with a standalone failure cause
records.root_cause_context: Manufacturer warns faulty coolant one-way valve may be cause; do not automatically replace IEM

diagnostic_steps.en: Confirm IEM-P0CBC62 and Propulsion System Service Required message. Match the Polestar 2 type 534 build/model-year scope.
diagnostic_steps.ar: تحقق من IEM-P0CBC62 ورسالة طلب صيانة نظام الدفع، ثم طابق الطراز وسنة الموديل.

diagnostic_steps.en: Use VIDA to trend IEM transistor temperatures of phases U, V and W while the vehicle is driven. Look for phase divergence and abnormal fluctuations.
diagnostic_steps.ar: سجّل منحنيات حرارة ترانزستورات IEM للأطوار U وV وW أثناء القيادة باستخدام VIDA، وافحص تباعد القيم وتذبذبها.

diagnostic_steps.en: For MY2024+ sensor outputs do not interpret the 55°C reported floor as actual coolant temperature. Under normal driving source says values below 65°C; faulty valve examples can fluctuate to 80–100°C.
diagnostic_steps.ar: في MY2024 وما بعده لا تعتبر 55°C القراءة الدنيا حرارة فعلية؛ تذكر النشرة أقل من 65°C أثناء القيادة الاعتيادية، و80–100°C في مثال صمام معيب.

diagnostic_steps.en: If test pattern matches the defective one-way valve, replace the appropriate hose/valve assembly per VIN and drivetrain; do not preemptively replace IEM.
diagnostic_steps.ar: عندما تطابق القراءات نمط تعطل الصمام أحادي الاتجاه، استبدل مجموعة الخرطوم/الصمام الملائمة حسب VIN والدفع دون تغيير IEM مسبقاً.

diagnostic_steps.en: If concern remains after appropriate hose replacement, resume VIDA fault tracing for other causes.
diagnostic_steps.ar: إذا استمر العطل بعد الإجراء المناسب، أكمل التشخيص وفق VIDA للأسباب الأخرى.

live_data.document_term_en: IEM transistor temperatures of phases U, V, W (exact VIDA PID labels unconfirmed)
live_data.translation_ar: درجة حرارة ترانزستورات العاكس للأطوار U وV وW
live_data.conditions: While driving; compare phase traces; MY2024+ has minimum displayed 55°C
live_data.reference_from_TJ: Below 65°C in regular driving; abnormal illustrated fluctuation 80–100°C

tools_needed: Polestar VIDA
VIDA data plotting of phase temperatures
